name: Previous preset
tip: Previous preset for this tab.

name: Preset list
tip: Presets for this tab: factory ones and your own. Moving a control shows Custom.

name: Next preset
tip: Next preset for this tab.

name: Save
tip: Save this tab's settings as your own preset (kept on this computer).

name: More
tip: Delete your presets or open the presets folder.

name: Guide
tip: Quick guide: what each view and control does.

name: Settings
tip: Info bubbles and the presets folder.

name: About & Support
tip: About Studio 87, privacy, and ways to support the project.

name: Shimmer Reverb
tip: The reverb view: plate, hall, shimmer plate, shimmer hall and velvet.

name: Shimmer Delay
tip: The delay view: echoes that climb (or fall) in pitch with every repeat. The routing stays as you set it on every tab.

name: FX and Routing
tip: Route the reverb and delay in series or side by side, and add saturation, squash, duck and width.

name: Main preset
tip: Main presets set the whole plugin: reverb, delay, FX and routing.

name: Save main preset
tip: Save the whole plugin as your own main preset.

name: Decay
tip: The measured decay of the real reverb. Yellow dot: decay (sideways) and size (up or down). Cyan: pre-delay. Blue: damping. Orange: shimmer. Pink: mix.

name: Tone
tip: Live spectrum of the input and output with draggable filter lines.

name: Decay view
tip: Drag the coloured dots; double-click a dot to reset it.

name: Level
tip: Input and output peaks, RMS, RT60, and the clip light.

name: Peak reset
tip: Clears the held peaks and the clip light.

name: ON
tip: Switches the reverb on or off. Same switch as the power icon in the routing diagram.

name: Type
tip: Plate, hall, shimmer plate, shimmer hall or velvet.

name: Decay knob
tip: Tail length.

name: Size
tip: Room size.

name: Pre-delay
tip: Gap before the reverb starts.

name: Modulation
tip: Slow movement inside the tail.

name: Velvet colour
tip: Velvet type only: dark to bright.

name: Shimmer pitch
tip: Pitch of the shimmer voice fed back into the tail.

name: Shimmer amount
tip: How much shifted tail is fed back.

name: Pitch 2
tip: Pitch of the second shimmer voice.

name: Amount 2
tip: Amount of the second shimmer voice.

name: Damping
tip: Darkens the tail.

name: Wet HP
tip: High-pass on the reverb tail only.

name: Wet LP
tip: Low-pass on the reverb tail only.

name: Mix
tip: Reverb dry/wet.
